privateDir.description: Harness-agnostic IP knowledge base directory, not shipped (default .private).

agents.description: Agents this repo is wired for.

backupMonorepo.description: True when this root is a backup monorepo managing deliverable sub-repos.

coordination.description: Settings for `specguard coordinate` (multi-front orchestration). All keys optional.

worktreeRoot.description: Where front worktrees are created, resolved relative to the repo root (default: ../.spec-guard-worktrees — always a sibling, never inside the repo).

testCommand.description: Test-gate command run before a front's sequential merge lands (default: null, falls back to package.json's scripts.test).

branchPrefix.description: Prefix for front branch names (default: spec-guard/coord).
